messages:
Priya: quick heads-up — tomorrow we have onsite candidate CX-47. Need final coverage + debrief owner. I'm planning a round-robin so folks don't get double-booked. If you need to swap, please call it out now.

Priya: current plan (rough):
```9:00–9:45 System design — Jordan
10:00–10:40 Coding — Elena
11:00–11:30 PM / Product — OPEN
11:45–12:15 Debrief + score normalization — Debrief owner: Priya
```

Jordan: I can do system design but I have a 10:30 sync. If someone can cover the last 10m of my slot (just for overlap), that'd help. @Samir you free to jump in at 9:35 if needed?

Samir: yep I can pick up 9:35–9:45 if Jordan needs to duck. Also can cover whole 9:00 slot if Jordan needs to swap.

Elena: coding slot is fine for me. For debrief scribe — I can take notes if Priya wants.

Priya: thanks. Elena — please scribe if you can. Debrief owner will surface rubric oddities and call for a quick normalization if scores diverge >1 point.

Kevin: quick rubric q: are we weighting product vs algo differently for this role? Last time we did 30/40/30 (communication/algo/product) but for CX-47 product emphasis should be higher, maybe 25/45/30?

Priya: good catch. For this role let's use: communication 25, algorithm 45, product 30. Please annotate any contextual notes in the scribe doc.

Jordan: :thumbsup: noted. Also I'll add a short prompt set to the coding exercise so interviewers see expected edge cases.

Elena: FYI — candidate asked about onsite parking. I replied with directions and transit options.

Priya: small logistics — we have a quiet room reserved (Q3) and a laptop, whiteboard. Please bring chargers. Lunch covered.

Samir: one more ask — normalization: do we z-score within this interview only or apply the usual cohort baseline?

Priya: normalize within this interview block only. If debrief owner thinks scores are an outlier vs baseline we'll flag and route to hiring committee for follow-up.

InterviewBot: reminder — candidate NDA received and background check pending.

Kevin: I'll take the product slot if no one else volunteers.

Priya: perfect — updated. Final schedule in the shared doc now. If anyone needs a swap after 5pm today ping me directly. Thanks all :heart:
